title: EBC 603: Alteration – Level 2
officialText:
603.1 Scope.

Level 2 alteration is any alteration made to a building where the work area exceeds 50 percent of the building area.

603.1.1 Work area contributing to Level 2 alteration.

For the purpose of determining Level 2 alteration, work area shall be calculated pursuant to Section 601.2.

Exception. For categories of work established by rule.

603.2 Application.

Level 2 alterations shall comply with the provisions of Chapter 8 for Level 1 alterations as well as the provisions of Chapter 9 and, as applicable, with the provisions of Chapters 3 and 7.
